worldcombat.skill.flatter.summary: Flatter the target, raising its Special Attack and leaving it dazed: its attempts may be lost in a daze, but it keeps moving freely while the raised Special Attack hurts everyone.
worldcombat.skill.flatter.use.0: Make a hard-hitting foe keep fumbling
worldcombat.skill.flatter.use.1: Break the rhythm of a special threat
worldcombat.skill.flatter.use.2: Add fuel to an already faltering enemy
worldcombat.skill.flatter.description.0: Flatter the target senseless: it gains %1$s Special Attack stages (its moves hit harder and it is more dangerous under focus) and is left dazed for about %2$s s. It is never pinned and keeps moving freely.
worldcombat.skill.flatter.description.1: While dazed, each attempt (including native special attacks) has a %1$s%% chance to be lost in a daze; the fumble only wastes that attempt and deals no damage.
worldcombat.skill.flatter.description.2: Telegraph %1$s s, recovery %2$s s, cooldown %3$s s, range %4$s blocks. Rapid patter adds to the gift and fumble chance but shortens the daze; a slow tribute lasts longer with a lighter gift.
worldcombat.skill.flatter.timing: Short windup and recovery; accurate and single target, paced by its cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.flatter.preference.ton: Rapid patter: gift +1 stage and fumble chance +12%%, but daze x0.7. Slow tribute: daze x1.35 for a long grind, with a lighter gift.
Only consider flattering a threat within this distance; larger opens earlier.
When on, the companion leaves its post to flatter.
